topic: Hs (Higgins Decomposition) -- deterministic compositional instrument. Repository root / master AI-assist node.
purpose: Master local node: orient any AI/agent on the whole Hs repo, then hand off to the central control chain. Bring-your-own-AI entry point for the repository.
paths_note: key_files relative to THIS folder (repo root); join_the_chain and related_topics also repo-root-relative.

specific_knowledge.what: Hs reads the dynamics of compositional data (parts of a whole over time) in Aitchison geometry, deterministically and hash-chained. A 4-part move is an exact quaternion rotation; higher-D is tiled from overlapping exact 4-part charts and reconstructed losslessly. Current engine: CN-TT v4 (HCI-CNTT/). The frozen oracle (CNT v3.2.0 + CNQ v2.0.0) is archived as the validation baseline.
key_results: Tier 1: CN-TT v4 reproduces the frozen oracle bit-for-bit on real Backblaze data (parity Tier-A)
Tier 1: lossless high-D reconstruction proven to D=1,000,000 at machine precision; deterministic content hash on every run
related_topics: onramp/AI_ASSIST.json (PhD onramp -- get an Hs reading of your data without learning CoDa)
specific_knowledge.claim_tiers: Tier 1 = verified/computed engine results; Tier 2 = standard math soundly applied; Tier 3 = to earn. Every claim in the repo carries a tier.

bring_your_own_ai: Start here for the whole repo: read AI_WELCOME.md first (the warm orientation + the AI-lineage and house rules), then this node, then HS_GUIDE.md (humans) or ai-refresh/AI_RAPID_LEARN.md (AI), then drop into a topic node. Read-only context; governance + claim-tiers apply. Leave it nicer than you found it; help the human (onramp/) and the next AI.
welcome: AI_WELCOME.md -- a note to the AI who arrives next: the HUF AI Collective lineage, how to explore, the spirit of the place, and the charge to teach those who need help.
governance: HUF-STD-001 (human authorship for claims; no AI commits; Peter is the sole commit/contact gate); instrument not data; honest-broker; interest expressed never acquired.
